text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Watching Kris S-san over these past few months
has made me realize something.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Whatever she resolves to do, she will always see it done. No matter how difficult, or conversely, how trivial it may be.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Bit by bit, I began to understand.
Just how difficult, and how truly noble that is.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Which is why, even on a grand stage like the Japanese Derby,
she will do what needs to be done.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (The hero's sword sparkles gallantly and seizes a magnificent victory—!)

"...The day of the 'Japanese Derby'.
The venue was packed with tremendous excitement."

Of course, Zenno Rob Roy, who had come
to cheer for Symboli Kris S, was no exception—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: D-Do your beeeest!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here he comes! Symboli Kris S
is surging up from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san will be fine, absolutely fine...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(She'll do what must be done—
Look, she's moving up, she's pushing forward,
she never wavers, no matter what!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Look, she passed! She's passing them! Even faster!
She's a hero, so she's gonna win! I saw it with my own eyes!! My hero—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: There's no way... I'm gonna lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And charging up from the far outside—it's Tanino Gimlet! Here comes Tanino Gimlet!!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —Huh.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet! It's Tanino Gimlet!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet crosses the line
in first place――!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...No way...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Gimlet really is a beast!!
I believed in ya, thanks a ton--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, what an insane late surge that was!!
Let's see, second place was... Symboli Kris S?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You both gave it your all!!
That was a great race!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: N-No way...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"None.
—I have resolved to accomplish it."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
“—Because that
is what must be done—right now.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —For the first time... I've made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san... after trying so... so hard.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That it's what must be done...!

The Nippon Derby is a race you can only enter once in your life.
...There are no second chances.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —That's...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't just sit still,
so I came all the way to the waiting room, but...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Is there anything someone like me could even say...?)
(—*murmur murmur...*)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—Though this Derby ended in a narrow
second-place defeat—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (She's already doing interviews...)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you share your candid thoughts
on falling short of your target for 1st place?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Wh-What a direct approach...!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I failed to fulfill my mission.
That is... something to be lamented.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: But—I will not dwell on it.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Take the results seriously, make a fresh start,
and do our best for the next race... is that what you mean?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: No. Nothing—changes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Future goals, my mission—they are all directly connected."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Are you saying the Derby's result won't affect Kris S.-san's future...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yes. From now on, as well—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I will simply do what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
choice_data_list: Are you sure you didn't want to talk to them?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...It just felt a bit tactless to do so.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No matter what I say or don't say, she probably won't change her mind... but still.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's why.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's why. ...It gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: She... Kris S-san truly remains completely unshakable to the end.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Even if your knees get soiled with dirt, even if a rematch is denied...
so long as you set your own path forward,
everything will be alright—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
With few words, he showed me that the tip of
the sword in his hand pointed solely toward the future.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...I realized that it was those qualities in them
that I truly admired.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I told you!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Staying true to the path you chose for yourself,
and becoming a guiding light for others.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: As if granting courage and hope with a single swing of a sword.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —I want to become an 'unwavering' hero just like that.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I can become one.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

I suddenly realize that despite it being dusk,
I don't feel chilly at all.

That warmth brings the realization—summer is here,
and the day of Zenno Rob Roy's debut
is drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best, okay!

The early summer breeze blew past comfortably.
I fervently wished that it would give her a gentle push from behind.
